Ask a question ⌘I All releases October 2, 2026 v2.13.0 Facet stats for number fields Searches with facets now return the lowest and highest value of every number field, ready for price sliders. Building a price slider used to take a second request to find the cheapest and most expensive product. Ask for a number field as a facet and the response now includes facetStats with its range. { "facetStats" : { "price" : { "min" : 19 , "max" : 349 } } } The range follows the query and the filters, so the slider always matches the results on screen.
